composition: Hard left type, work as a directory or abrupt blocks. Little pastoral photography.
typography: Compressed grotesques, sudden scale jumps, mixed case on purpose.
palette: Industrial: black, off-white, an unexpected signal color that is not purple.
geometry: Directory rows, hard edges, few rounded cards.
hero: Name + a blunt line. No 3D ornament required.
interaction: Hover states like buttons on a device.
spatial_rhythm: Dense directory vs sudden empty band.
